orig: Dear Heavenly Father, we gather here today in your presence. We come with open hearts and minds ready to receive your Word. We ask for your guidance as we delve into Revelation 22. Let your Holy Spirit fill this place. May your message of hope and restoration touch each one of us. In Jesus' name we pray. Amen. As we begin, let us open our hearts to the divine message. Today we will explore the final chapter of the Bible. Revelation 22 speaks of a glorious future. It promises a restored Eden, a place of eternal joy and peace. Let us journey together through this powerful scripture. Our focus today will be on the themes of restoration, hope, and eternal life. These are the promises God has given us. They are the foundation of our faith. Let us embrace these promises with open hearts. Revelation 22 paints a picture of a new beginning, a fresh start that is both beautiful and profound. It shows us a vision of Eden restored, a paradise regained. This chapter is the culmination of God's plan, the grand finale of His divine narrative. It is a promise of what is to come, a glimpse into the future that awaits us. It gives us hope for the future, a hope that is steadfast and unwavering. The chapter starts with the river of the water of life, a river that flows eternally. It flows from the throne of God and the Lamb, symbolizing divine grace and mercy. This river symbolizes the eternal life that God offers us, a life that is pure and unending. It is pure, clear as crystal, and it nourishes the tree of life, sustaining it forever. The tree of life stands on each side of the river a symbol of eternal sustenance. It bears 12 kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit every month, a testament to God's provision. The leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations, bringing peace and restoration. This imagery reminds us of the Garden of Eden, a place of perfect harmony. It is a place of abundance and healing, where every need is met. As we reflect on these verses, we see God's promise of restoration, a promise that is both comforting and inspiring. He will make all things new, bringing forth a new creation. He will bring us back to a place of perfection, a place where we can dwell with Him forever. This is the hope we hold on to, a hope that anchors our souls and gives us strength. Dear Lord, we thank You for the promise of restoration. We thank You for the hope of a new Eden. We ask that You help us hold on to this hope. Strengthen our faith as we wait for Your return. Help us to live in a way that honors You. Guide us in our daily lives. Let Your light shine through us in Jesus' name, we pray, amen. As we continue, let us keep this prayer in our hearts, allowing it to guide our thoughts and actions. Let us remember that God's promises are true, steadfast, and unchanging, providing us with a foundation of hope and faith. He will restore all things, bringing renewal and healing to every part of our lives in the world around us. He will bring us back to a place of perfection, a place where peace and harmony reigns supreme. This is the hope we cling to, a hope that unites us and strengthens our resolve to live faithfully. The angel's message to John in Revelation 22 is also significant, offering profound insights and divine revelations. It is a message that speaks to us today, resonating with our current struggles and aspirations. It is a message of urgency and importance, calling us to immediate and thoughtful action. Let us explore this message together, delving into its depths and uncovering its truths. Section 5. The angel's message to John, a pivotal part of the revelation narrative. The angel's showed John the river of the water of life, a symbol of eternal sustenance and divine grace. He showed him the tree of life, bearing fruit that grants everlasting life and healing. He showed him the city where the throne of God and the Lamb would be, a place of ultimate authority and divine presence. This vision was a glimpse of the future, a future filled with divine light and eternal joy. It was a promise of what has to come, a promise that fills us with hope and anticipation. The angel told John that these words are trustworthy and true, affirming the reliability of God's revelations. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place, ensuring they are prepared. This message is a reminder that God's promises are reliable, a beacon of truth in the world of uncertainty. We can trust in His Word, knowing that it is a firm foundation for our lives. The angel also said, we hold I am coming soon, a declaration that fills us with both urgency and hope. Blessed is He who keeps the words of the prophecy in this book. A call to faithful adherence and vigilance. This is a call to action, urging us to live out the truth we have received. It is a reminder that we must live according to God's Word, embodying its principles in our daily lives. We must be prepared for His return, living each day with a sense of readiness and expectation. This message is relevant to us today, speaking directly to our contemporary context and challenges. We are called to keep the words of the prophecy, ensuring that they guide our thoughts and actions. We are called to live in a way that honors God, reflecting His love and truth in all we do. We are called to be ready for His return, maintaining a posture of alertness and spiritual preparedness. This is a message of urgency and importance, one that demands our immediate attention and response. Section 6. Second Prayer Dear Lord, we thank You for Your Word. We thank You for the message of the angel, help us to keep the words of the prophecy, help us to live according to Your will. Prepare our hearts for Your return. Give us the strength to follow You every day. Let Your Word guide us in all that we do in Jesus' name we pray. Amen. As we continue, let us keep this prayer in our hearts, allowing it to guide our thoughts and actions. Let us remember the importance of living according to God's Word, embracing its teachings in every aspect of our lives. Let us be ready for His return, always living in a state of preparedness and hope. This is the call to action that we must heed, a call to live with purpose and conviction. The epilogue of Revelation 22 contains an invitation and a warning, both of which are crucial for us to understand. It is a message that we must take to heart, a message that speaks to the core of our faith. Let us explore this together, delving into the depths of its meaning and significance. Section 7. The invitation and warning, a pivotal part of our spiritual journey. The Spirit and the Bride say, come, this is a call that echoes through the ages, and let Him who hears say, come, it is a call to all who are willing to listen, whoever is thirsty, let Him come. This is an invitation to quench our deepest spiritual thirst. Whoever wishes, let Him take the free gift of the water of life. This gift is available to all who seek it. This is an open invitation extended to everyone without exception. It is an invitation to eternal life, a promise of everlasting joy and peace. It is a call to all who are thirsty for God's love, a love that surpasses all understanding. This invitation is a reminder of God's grace, a grace that is freely given to us. It is a reminder that salvation is a free gift, not something we can earn through our own efforts. We do not have to earn it, for it is given to us out of God's boundless love. We only need to accept it with open hearts and minds. This is the hope that we have in Christ, a hope that fills us with joy and peace. The epilogue also contains a warning, a solemn reminder of the seriousness of God's word. It warns against adding or taking away from the words of the prophecy, a warning that we must heed. If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book, a dire consequence for altering God's word. If anyone takes words away, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, a loss that is unimaginable. This warning is a reminder of the importance of God's word, a word that we must cherish and respect. It is a reminder that we must handle it with care, understanding its sacredness. We must not alter it to suit our desires, but rather let it transform us. We must accept it as it is, embracing its truth and wisdom. This is the responsibility that we have as believers to uphold and live by the word of God. Dear Lord, we thank You for Your invitation to eternal life. We thank You for the free gift of salvation. Help us to accept this gift with grateful hearts. Help us to live in a way that honors You. Guide us as we share Your word with others. Let Your message of hope and restoration spread throughout the world. In Jesus' name we pray, amen. Thank You for joining us today. We hope that this message has touched your heart. We hope that it has given you hope and inspiration. If you have been blessed by this sermon, please subscribe to our channel. Your support helps us to continue sharing God's word. Please like this video. Your likes help us reach more people. They help us spread the message of hope and restoration. Every like makes a difference. Share this video with your friends and family. Let them hear the message of Revelation 22. Let them know about the promise of Eden restored. Let them experience the hope that we have in Christ. Together we can spread the word of God. Together we can share the message of hope and restoration. Thank You for Your support. God bless you all. God. As we close, let us listen to some background gospel music. Let the music uplift your spirit. Let it remind you of God's promises. Let it fill your heart with hope and joy. Music has a way of touching our souls. It can bring us closer to God. It can remind us of his love and grace. Let us take a moment to enjoy this music. Let it be a time of reflection and worship. Feel the presence of God as you listen. Let his peace fill your heart. Let his love surround you. This is a time to connect with him. This is a time to be still and know that he is God. Thank you for being here today. Thank you for being part of this journey. May God's blessings be with you always. As we end our sermon today, let us carry the message of Revelation 22 in our hearts. Let us hold on to the hope of Eden restored. Let us live in a way that honors God. Let us be ready for his return. Remember the promises of God. He will make all things new. He will bring us back to a place of perfection. This is the hope that sustains us. This is the promise that we cling to. Thank you for joining us today. We hope that this message has inspired you. We hope that it has given you hope and joy. May God bless you and keep you. May his face shine upon you and give you peace. Go in peace and may the love of God be with you always. Amen. Your assignment for this week is to tell someone about Jesus and donate to your local food pantry. Together we can all help feed the world one mouth at a time.
